sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The Nut can is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 9 inventory slots in a 3x3 grid and only takes up 1 inventory slot itself.It can only store:
- Screw nuts
- Bolts
- Pack of nails
- Pack of screws
